newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted as bids and offers on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. There were no trades versus none on Monday.
- Four barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, one each week of May, bid 135 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Nine barges, Lacrosse-Savage, upper Mississippi River, bid140 percent, no comparison, offer 150 percent.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of September, bid 155 percent, no comparison, offer 165 percent.
